description: For the signed-in vendor: asks to submit a proposal package on one of your leads, written by code against the market's published proposal model: scope lines included or excluded, phases with duration and dependency, price lines (component, unit, quantity, unit price, currency), assumptions and exclusions, a short note per section, and the currency, term in months and annual escalator. Nothing is submitted by this tool: it checks the package, names any field that needs a change, and returns a link to PreShiftIQ's confirm page, where the owner of the vendor record confirms. A client sees the package only after asking you for proposals.
name: submit_proposal_package
title: Submit a proposal package
